import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(path,chain=None):
    res={};het=[]
    for ln in open(path):
        rec=ln[:6].strip()
        if rec=="HETATM" and ln[17:20].strip()=="MG" and (chain is None or ln[21]==chain):
            het.append(np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])]))
        if rec not in ("ATOM","HETATM"): continue
        if chain and ln[21]!=chain: continue
        rn=ln[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3 or ln[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        res.setdefault(int(ln[22:26]),{"aa":AA3[rn],"at":{}})["at"][ln[12:16].strip()]=np.array(
            [float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
    return res,het
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    return Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T, None
lra,mg=parse(PR+"8GSR.pdb","A"); bll,_=parse(PR+"AF-Q89GC3.pdb")
def fit(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T
    return R,qc-R@pc
ap=lambda R,t,X:(R@X.T).T+t
seed=[(119,140),(121,142),(150,171)]
R,t=fit(np.array([lra[a]["at"][x] for a,b in seed for x in ("CA","CB")]),
        np.array([bll[b]["at"][x] for a,b in seed for x in ("CA","CB")]))
lk=sorted(lra);bk=sorted(bll)
LCA=np.array([lra[k]["at"]["CA"] for k in lk]);BCA=np.array([bll[k]["at"]["CA"] for k in bk])
